reviewer: independent second-pass visual reviewer (Claude subagent, not the builder)
review_depth: quick, exterior only (about 20 minutes); interior ignored; explicit colour check

deductions.reason: End-block muntin pattern is wrong. The model uses an equal 4-wide x 3-high grid (12 panes) on single wide openings. The user close-up, purdue_2018_facade (N-block west face) and bsa_exterior (end block) show units 2 lites wide: a short top pane, a tall middle pane and a short bottom pane. Wider openings are paired units with a frame pier between them (single, pair, pair, single on the N-block west face).
Glazed-range bay frames are neutral grey (render 128,126,121). The photos show a warm bronze-taupe (bsa_exterior 170,145,116 sunlit; purdue_2018 180,171,131).
Glass is a flat, uniform blue-grey (86,100,108) everywhere. The photos read dark (43,49,45 in the close-up) with strong sky reflections, so the windows look lighter and more painted than real.

The glazed-range 'W' struts are large flat W shapes in the facade plane. From every oblique (G_V01, G_V02) they read as a row of letters 'W W W W' floating in front of the eave. bsa_exterior shows slim dark paired struts on each pier line that project out to the soffit, reading as thin brackets.

The eave frieze on the end blocks is a tall (~1.5 m) plain light-grey band, rendered 120-128 grey in shade. purdue_2018 (N-block corner crop), bsa_exterior and the user close-up show, above the floor-3 heads: the stone string course, then a brick frieze about 0.8-1 m tall with diaper, then a slim stone cornice under the dark soffit.

The diaper reads as bold drawn crossing lines (~0.6 m module, strokes about 2 courses thick), which make X-chains where the strips flank the windows. The photos show a fine, dense net of single dark headers that looks like texture rather than lines. Placement in the window columns is correct per the user close-up.
Arcade canopies are plain grey (98,102,95). bsa_exterior shows verdigris/copper-patina canopies (146,155,123) with dark hangers.
The eave zone is top-heavy. The plain grey frieze plus deep soffit make the cornice zone about twice the height seen in purdue_2018/bsa_exterior, where brick runs up close to the soffit.
Red roof tile is visible under the glazed-range eave at the NW junction (G_V04 top left), and a frame/grille fragment sticks out past the first pier into the stair-tower bay.

Roof tile is still too saturated and orange-red, the user's specific complaint. Top render vs aerial at the same viewpoint: render 146,86,69 (hue 13 deg, saturation 0.53) vs aerial 149-168,121-137,101-114 (hue 25 deg, saturation 0.32). purdue_2018 (S block, shade) shows a deeper red-brown, 103,60,61. Target about 140,100,85 sunlit, hue ~18-22 deg, saturation ~0.38-0.42. The change-log target of ~150,120,100 is not reached in the renders.
A large untextured white surface (217,220,221) is exposed on the courtyard/east side, above the one-storey east wing against the far end block. It is visible in G_V09, G_east_side and obl_SE.

Brick is slightly too pink and dark. Render 126,91,79 (hue 15 deg) vs close-up 144,112,90 (hue 24), bsa 136,103,84 (hue 22) and purdue_2018 sunlit 166,120,94 (hue 22). Shift about 8 deg toward orange-brown and lift value about 10%.
Soffit and frieze are neutral grey (55,55,55 and 120-128). The photos show a warm dark bronze-brown soffit (purdue_2018 37,33,34 in shade; bsa 103,84,58 with bounce light).
Small hue misses: glazed-range bay frames neutral grey vs bronze-taupe; canopies grey vs verdigris; letters neutral grey (115,112,105) vs bronze (138,119,92).
White untextured wall on the courtyard/east side. This is the r01 'south-block east junction' hole, still open, and it reads as missing exterior skin.
Two stray bits: a small white box at the east (G_V09, about x1340-1385, y535-560), and the projecting frame fragment at the NW junction (G_V04).

colour_check.method: Median sRGB of matched patches (percentile-selected for thin features) from the r3 renders and the reference photos; script and patch boxes in review_r03/sample_colours.py and colour_patches_*.json, montages colour_patches_*.png. Lighting differs between sources, so verdicts weigh hue and relative value more than absolute value.

findings.facade: Courtyard/east side, end block above the one-storey east wing
findings.required_correction: Skin this face in brick with belt/string courses and windows matching the adjacent east faces. It is visible in G_V09, G_east_side and obl_SE.
Desaturate and shift toward brown: aim for sunlit render ~140,100,85 (hue ~20 deg, saturation ~0.4), checked in r3_top against aerial_world_imagery.png. The current render is 146,86,69.

Each unit 2 lites wide, with a short top pane, a tall middle pane and a short bottom pane (user close-up, purdue_2018, bsa_exterior). Split wide openings into paired units with a frame pier, following the photo rhythm (N-block west face: single, pair, pair, single).
Replace the facade-plane W shapes with slim dark-bronze paired struts on each pier centreline, projecting perpendicular to the facade from the pier face to the soffit (bsa_exterior).

Above the floor-3 string course, use a ~0.8-1 m brick frieze (with diaper per the user close-up and purdue_2018) topped by a ~0.3 m stone cornice. Remove the tall plain grey frieze band and give the soffit a warm dark bronze-brown (~60,48,40).
Use a finer, single-header-width lattice: thinner strokes and a smaller module, so it reads as a brick net. Clip it at straight vertical edges of the window columns instead of ending in X-chains.
Bay frames warm bronze-taupe (~150,130,105 sunlit), canopies verdigris (~140,150,120), letters bronze (~130,110,85).
Shift about 8 deg toward orange-brown and lift value ~10% (target sunlit ~142,108,88).

Darker base colour with some specular/sky reflection, so the glazing reads dark like the photos.

uncertainties: Quick review (about 20 minutes), exterior only; interior ignored. No extra renders were made; r3 renders were used as delivered.
Window-frame colour sources conflict: the user close-up shows taupe-grey, while bsa_exterior and purdue_2018 read near-white in direct sun. The user close-up was given priority as instructed.

Exactly how far the diaper extends beside each window could not be settled from the photos at hand. The user's description (window columns only, plain piers/corners) was accepted, and the model follows it.
Colour pairs mix lighting conditions (summer sun, winter low sun, overcast phone photo, hazy aerial); verdicts weigh hue and relative value.
East faces have no photo coverage; only obvious defects (untextured white wall) were scored there.
Downpipe stand-off from the wall was not measured; it looked acceptable in the G views.
